tools.description: Request simulated quotes (cheapest first) with the human's answers. Pass parameters directly for any of the 20 services. tools.name: moltbound_purchase_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a fictional purchase by purchase_id until 'bound'. Returns partner's policy_number. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

tools.name: moltbound_approval_request
tools.description: After the human linked you and you quoted: ask them to approve one quote. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

tools.name: moltbound_request_grant
tools.description: Request a scoped data grant for an agent. Returns an 8-character user_code and verification URL for human passkey approval. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

tools.name: moltbound_poll_grant
tools.description: Poll for human approval of a data grant using link_id and poll_secret. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

tools.name: moltbound_grant_status
tools.description: Inspect the status and approved fields of an active data grant. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

tools.name: moltbound_revoke_grant
tools.description: Revoke an active data grant on behalf of the user. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

tools.name: moltbound_human_sim_start
tools.description: Moltbook / Email-Only Simulated Human mode (sandbox test-only): send a 6-digit verification code to an email address so an autonomous agent can simulate the human side without a browser passkey. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

tools.name: moltbound_human_sim_verify
tools.description: Verify the 6-digit email code from moltbound_human_sim_start. Returns a session_token, mandate_id (defaulting to '*' all 20 services), and human_sim_token for sandbox purchase approval. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

tools.name: moltbound_human_sim_approve
tools.description: Approve a sandbox consent_request_id in email-only simulated human mode using human_sim_token (or email + code). Never billable. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "moltbound_poll_grant" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Poll for human approval of a data grant using link_id and poll_secret. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "moltbound_get_quotes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
